outlets.name: MICHELIN Guide — Philadelphia (inaugural 2025 edition)
outlets.credible: International culinary authority; Philadelphia got its own Michelin guide in 2025 (stars, Bib Gourmand, Recommended). Any distinction is institutional ground truth on its own.

outlets.name: James Beard Foundation Awards
outlets.credible: National culinary authority; Philadelphia winners, nominees, semifinalists and America's Classics honorees. Institutional mark.

outlets.name: National Park Service (Independence NHP, Valley Forge NHP, Edgar Allan Poe NHS, Gloria Dei, Thaddeus Kosciuszko)
outlets.credible: Federal operator of the founding-history sites; authoritative for sites it operates (lone institutional authority).

outlets.name: The Philadelphia Inquirer (incl. food critic Craig LaBan)
outlets.credible: The city's daily paper of record since 1829; Craig LaBan is the James Beard-winning restaurant critic of record (bell ratings, cheesesteak and hoagie surveys).

outlets.name: Philadelphia Magazine (incl. Foobooz, 50 Best Restaurants, Best of Philly)
outlets.credible: The city magazine of record since 1908; annual 50 Best Restaurants and Best of Philly awards are the local benchmark.

outlets.name: Eater Philly
outlets.credible: Vox Media's Philadelphia food desk; bylined maps (essential 38, best cheesesteaks, best hoagies) and opening/closing news.

outlets.name: The Infatuation — Philadelphia
outlets.credible: National restaurant guide with a dedicated Philadelphia staff; bylined reviews and guides.

outlets.name: Visit Philadelphia (official tourism marketing corp.)
outlets.credible: The city's official tourism body; authoritative listings of attractions, neighbourhoods and food icons.

outlets.name: PHL CVB / discoverPHL
outlets.credible: Philadelphia Convention & Visitors Bureau; official visitor guidance.

outlets.name: Billy Penn at WHYY
outlets.credible: WHYY's local-news site; strong on neighbourhood institutions, food history and local picks.

outlets.name: WHYY (Philadelphia NPR/PBS member station)
outlets.credible: Public broadcaster of record for the Delaware Valley; news, culture and food reporting.

outlets.name: PhillyVoice
outlets.credible: Established local digital newsroom; openings/closings and food features.

outlets.name: Atlas Obscura
outlets.credible: Curated catalogue of oddities and hidden gems; editorially reviewed entries.

outlets.name: Hidden City Philadelphia
outlets.credible: Non-profit urbanism & history publication; authoritative on the city's built heritage and hidden places.

outlets.name: Wikipedia
outlets.credible: Notability + published coordinates for landmarks; corroborating only.

outlets.name: The place's own official site
outlets.credible: Authority on its own address/hours/status; never a lone recommender.

outlets.name: The New York Times
outlets.credible: National paper of record; Restaurant List / travel coverage of Philadelphia.

outlets.name: Bon Appétit
outlets.credible: National food magazine (Best New Restaurants lists).

outlets.name: Time Out
outlets.credible: International city-guide brand; bylined Philadelphia guides.

outlets.name: Mural Arts Philadelphia
outlets.credible: The nation's largest public-art program (city-founded 1984); authoritative on the city's murals.

outlets.name: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Fairmount Park Conservancy
outlets.credible: Municipal operator of Fairmount Park, the Wissahickon and city parks.

outlets.name: Lonely Planet
outlets.credible: Major travel guide publisher; editorial top sights.

outlets.name: Condé Nast Traveler
outlets.credible: Major travel magazine; bylined city guides.

outlets.name: 6abc Action News (WPVI)
outlets.credible: Philadelphia's top-rated TV news; openings/closings, local favourites — corroborating.

outlets.name: New Jersey Monthly
outlets.credible: The state's magazine of record; South Jersey dining coverage.

outlets.name: Main Line Today
outlets.credible: Regional magazine of record for the Main Line & western suburbs; Best of the Main Line.

outlets.name: Courier-Post (Cherry Hill, NJ)
outlets.credible: South Jersey's daily paper; Camden-county dining & closings.
